description:
Drop-In Series Fuel Systems: https://fassride.com/shop/product-category/fuel-air-separation-systems/drop-in-series/

The Drop-In Series Fuel System for 2017-2024 Ford F-250/F-350/F-450s with the 6.7 Powerstroke diesel engine is HERE!

Engineered to be installed in your driveway, the Drop-In Series System upgrade eliminates over 99% of the water from diesel fuel, along with air/vapor, and debris down to 2 Microns absolute.

Through superior filtration, the Drop-In Series Fuel System can 3x the life of expensive injection components, optimize fuel efficiency, restore power, sharpen throttle response, and more!

Thanks for watching!
